content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the entire one-plus-hour video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the highlights from the event below.

Apple releases event highlight reel

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, alongside the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for nearly 1 hour and 20 minutes, staying true to Apple's signature style with executives taking turns addressing the camera, interspersed with marketing demos and product advertisements.

If you don't have time to watch the whole thing, Apple has also put out a rather fun highlight reel that summarizes each announcement, with narration weaving through the footage using rewind and fast-forward effects.

Apple has also uploaded the full presentation segment for each individual product, which you can watch below.
